src: I think you could talk to him now. Get a piece of savored meat of a saved Titan.
I am looking for someone who can help me acquire a fine taste.
That someone could be me.
What do you need exactly?
The Seneschal from the Collectors wants to expand his palate.
He wants to taste something 'extraordinary'.
Oh. I know the Collectors. Won't be pleased easily.
I could help you with that. Later.
Because right now I have a taste problem of my own.
It's the worm in the pen.
There's actually something that would be the pinnacle of taste in this city, I can tell you that.
You cannot get it right away, but I can show it to you.
Let's walk over to the Meat Quarry.
Welcome, friendly flesh enthusiast.
Welcome to my humble place where we will talk about meat.
You are interested in meat, yes?
You look a bit tart yourself, but also like having a full bouquet.
Hey. Stop that. That's mine.
That's the worm I meant.
Wait! You're not allowed to go back to the habitat.
You would risk contaminating the other citizens.
To prevent this, your life will be terminated if you enter the prohibited zone.
Please leave this corridor.
Welcome, visitor.
Hey!
Let's talk.
Come on. Next!
Next one.
You. Move.
Next!
Next.
{The creature relaxes and lets go of the Flesh Spikes.}
Hey. You wanna look at my stuff?
Show me what you have.
Don't do anything stupid.
I'm watching you.
Wanderer! I salute you.
Wanderer!
I heard about you. You helped us overcome the machines.
This one looks broken.
Ohhh... I don't feel so well.
Blergh.
I should get this fixed.
Maybe there's a doctor out there somewhere.
NAME: Stationary Titan Support System.
[Check status.]
STATUS: Reflux filter working at one hundred percent.
ERROR: Reflux filter efficiency at zero percent.
ERROR: Reflux filter in need of replacement.
Fuck this thing.
[Try replacing broken filter.]
I don't carry a fitting replacement with me.
ATTENTION: New reflux filter installed.
That seems to have done it.
It's some Flesh Titan.
It's Mother.
Looks like some scientific workstation.
It's completely destroyed.
Planet Nexus. Centuries after the Bleeding.
Amongst remnants of old civilizations...
...humanity rests in silent cities.
While machines wander, passing judgment.
And the outcasts try to survive.
What?
Noooooooo!
You're still wandering around here?
You should give your mind a bit of a rest sometimes, my friend.
Please. I'm just here for a bit of solitude.
Anything bothering you?
It's... it's nothing. I just like to reminisce sometimes.
About the actions I did.
You see, I was taking care of my Titan. I was a guardian.
While the Titan was used as a feeder still.
I didn't see much wrong with it then. Or, to be honest, I didn't want to think much about it.
But now it bothers you?
Yes, it does.
Apart from the obvious gruesome act... it's also just plain wrong?
It's like taking advantage of someone innocent. For years. For decades. Maybe centuries?
But you said it was useful for both sides.
I don't know. Can't shake the feeling we did them wrong, the Titans.
Anyway. Please let me have some solitude now.
[Stay silent.]
Thank you for taking part in my thoughts.
A feeder?
Oh, so you don't know about this.
Sorry, I don't really want to talk about it.
Maybe it's enough to say that it was more like a partnership.
We got the meat. They get... whatever they get out of it. I'm not really sure.
I'm looking for this place called Tauris.
Got a bit lost on my way.
You know how I can get there?
I'm sorry, I don't.
What a pity.
I guess I'll have to find it on my own then.
Just follow that path...
Perfect. I'll be on my way then.
It's right over there...
Just go this way...
Hey, are you from around here?
Not really.
Well, it doesn't really matter if you're from here or there
Kind of.
Hach, the Puke Bar....
If only I had a drink...
I could walk so much longer...
If this goes on, I'll never find the Puke Bar.
You wouldn't happen to have something with you, right?
How about this bottle of booze?
Yes, yes!
This is great.
Give it to me. I'll compensate you fairly.
Thank you so much.
I'll never forget what you did for me.
Once I get to the Puke Bar, I'm sure the drinks will be marvellous.
How did this happen?
I was so sure I would find it this time.
But the Puke Bar just won't show up, no matter how far I walk.
I must be cursed or something.
How am I supposed to get a drink now?
You wouldn't happen to have something with you, right?
Several people have told me the way, yet the Puke Bar is nowhere to be seen.
Wish me luck.
Don't worry about me.
I'm sure I'll find it this time.
You told me the way after all.
We meet again.
Good news.
I've given up on reaching Tauris.
It doesn't matter if you know the way or not.
I'm now trying to get to this Puke Bar place.
Somebody told me that it should be close by...
If somebody told you, they're probably right...
You think so too? That's a good sign.
Yeah, almost here. Look...
Perfect. Can't wait for a good drink.
Actually it's quite far away...
I made sure to follow what you said precisely this time.
Yet I still couldn't find it.
No worries though.
I've met somebody else. They told me about this Puke Bar.
I think it's supposed to be near here...
I'll find my way to Tauris. Even without your help.
Tauris. Right.
You just told me, where I need to go.
This direction, right?
Oh, hey! It's you again.
I'm still lost.
As lost as last time.
You wouldn't happen to have learned where Tauris is by now?
If you have, can you tell me?
No idea...
Well, I'll guess I'll have to follow my instincts then.
Just this way, towards the horizon...
Great. I'm sure I'll find it this time.
It's just a bit in this direction...
Even though you told me the way, I still haven't managed to find this Tauris place.
Just my luck, I guess.
But you know where it is, right?
Can you point me towards it?
This bottle you've given me...
It was so good.
I really need to find this Puke Bar place and have some more.
Acquiring target for remote trigger termination...
Please stop this violence.
Stop this!
Move along. No entry allowed.
That machine looks interesting. I don't know its purpose though.
Processing...
Target acquired. Proceeding...
I already took what I wanted.
Nothing to do here anymore.
Looks like I can open the machine and grab the insides.
[Take the Machine Core.]
I have it.
Probably useful.
That might be the Machine Core I was looking for.
Ha! You're out of luck.
It's still closed.
We could try to get in there.
Impossible.
At least from where we are standing.
What is?
The entrance to the Great Perished One.
Every few months I come by and check if someone opened it.
They say it's dead. It's all dead in there.
But I don't believe it.
Bah.
Tired of eating meat all the time.
I bet they have better stuff in the city.
It's a bed.
It's MY bed.
Though I could share it with you.
Nah, I'm okay.
So. What do you want?
Nothing, really.
Then please leave me be.
And please close the door behind you.
Just looking around.
Getting to know people?
Something like that, I guess.
Well, I'm Marla. I'm old, so I just stay here most of the time.
I'm friends with everyone though.
Everyone?
Yeah. Agira's best though. She takes care of me.
Even brought me cheese that one day. Only time I had some, apart from Cyberwomb.
Anything else?
I met this... Kraken. And it needs a friend.
A friend for the Kraken, you say? ... Wait!
Are you talking about one of the Titans here?
I guess. ... It seemed a bit lonely.
Ohh. Really? I suppose they could have feelings like that.
Did you ever meet the Kraken?
No. You think I would ever leave Tauris again? I'm not as mad as you, traveling through the world.
So where would I get a friend for the Kraken?
I don't know, really. ... Oh wait. Maybe Mortus can help you.
Yes. He's a good one.
Knows all kinds of stuff about the flesh.
He's living underground in the old facilities.
You can get there through one of the other houses.
Ok. Thanks.
Oh, I've met him. Thanks.
Hey! Close the door, please.
Meat! You want to buy some meat?
Is it safe to eat it raw like that?
Yeah. Everyone around here does.
What's with all the meat everywhere, anyway?
It's just there. Grows.
Oh, and takes craftsmanship to pick the best pieces of course.
Yeah, but where does it come from?
Honestly, I don't know.
As far as I remember it has always been growing everywhere, right from the ground.
Maybe we're living on a planet full of flesh and right now we're standing on a crust of stone and dirt.
So, do you want a piece of meat now?
Fresh meat for everyone.
Hey, you're new here, right?
Here's your meat.
We take care of everyone. If you want more though, you have to pay.
Hey. I'm busy.
Have to prepare this fine meat.
Talk to Gonzo if you want to have some.
[Murmurs something.]
Hmmh.
[Says nothing.]

There's a broom, a bucket and a bunch of squished bottles.
And some porn mags.
Oldschool.
